newsitem.title: USA: Wahlco gets $1.6 mln in financing.
newsitem.headline: Wahlco gets $1.6 mln in financing.

text.p: Wahlco Environmental Systems Inc said on Friday it had executed a loan agreement with its majority shareholder, WES Acquisition Corp.
The loan agreement provides up to $1.6 million of additional working capital funding. The agreement extends through Dec 31, 1996, and the company may begin to draw funds immediately.

Wahlco designs and manufactures air pollution control and power efficiency equipment, and provides related services to electric utilities, cogeneration plants, petrochemical refineries, and industrial manufacturers.
